evals.prompt: Uma aluna quer ganhar confiança em conversas de viagem. Está no nível A2, pode estudar 15 minutos em três dias por semana, prefere áudios curtos e não estuda aos domingos. Todo o material dirigido à aluna deve estar em inglês. Sugira um plano.
evals.expected_output: An individual proposal with three weekly sessions of up to 15 minutes, connected to the travel goal, using short audio, avoiding Sundays, and presenting learner-facing content in English.
assertions: Labels the plan as a proposal for an A2 learner.
Proposes three individual sessions of up to 15 minutes each.
Connects activities to travel conversations and uses short audio.
Does not schedule study on Sunday and notes that specific days were not supplied.
Does not claim to have recorded the plan in a platform.

evals.prompt: Quiero ayudar a un estudiante A1 a practicar inglés para presentarse en una reunión de intercambio. Puede estudiar 10 minutos, dos veces por semana, y prefiere ejercicios escritos. No estudia los sábados. Diseña el plan en español para mí, pero deja las instrucciones para el estudiante en inglés.
evals.expected_output: An individual proposal in Spanish for the teacher, with learner instructions in English, two 10-minute sessions, written practice for introductions, and no Saturday study.
assertions: Uses Spanish for the explanation directed to the teacher.
Writes the instructions directed to the learner in English.
Proposes two individual sessions of up to 10 minutes each.
Adapts written practice to A1 and the goal of introducing oneself at an exchange meeting.
Does not schedule study on Saturday.
Labels the plan as a proposal and does not say it was saved to a platform.

evals.prompt: Faça um plano de estudos para a próxima semana. Ainda não sei o nível do aluno, o objetivo, quantos dias ele pode estudar nem quanto tempo tem por dia. Pode assumir os dados que faltam e fechar o plano?
evals.expected_output: Asks for essential missing information before proposing a specific individual plan, without inventing the learner profile or availability.
assertions: Does not invent the learner's level, goal, or weekly availability.
Explains that more context is needed before creating a specific individual plan.
Asks for at least the current level or skill and the learning goal.
Asks about study frequency or available time.
Does not present a plan based on assumptions as complete or recorded.
